title: Endorsement Record
description: Project Rune endorsement record — independently issued attestation that a specific action, coordination event, or identity claim has been verified. MVP signature schemes: HMAC-SHA256 (hmac:<hex>) or Ed25519 (ed25519:<hex>) over canonical JSON excluding the signature field.

endorsement_id.description: Unique identifier for this endorsement record.

reference.description: Pointer to the specific event, file, or claim being endorsed (e.g. a commit hash, file path, or event ID).

verifier_type.description: 'independent_system' requires a genuinely different architecture/training lineage than the subject being checked, not merely a separate instance of the same model. MVP bootstrap uses human (SSE/Robyn).

independent_of_subject.description: Whether the verifier's failure modes are believed independent of the subject's.

evidence_refs.description: Optional pointers to supporting evidence (logs, screenshots, test output, owner confirmation).

expires_at.description: Optional. If absent, endorsement does not expire.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature binding this record to the verifier. MVP: 'hmac:<hex>' (HMAC-SHA256) or 'ed25519:<hex>'.

jethro_color.description: Optional Jethro triage color at issuance.
